is_anopheles.evidence: The study uses Anopheles funestus strains FANG and FUMOZ-R.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper does not genotype any of the listed insecticide-resistance markers. It explicitly states on page 2: 'Interestingly, despite high levels of pyrethroid resistance in An. funestus VGSC mutations known to confer kdr have not yet been described'.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses laboratory-maintained strains (FUMOZ-R and FANG), not field-collected populations.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study investigating cross-resistance and P450-mediated detoxification.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study uses laboratory strains, not field-collected samples.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study uses laboratory strains, not field-collected samples.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study uses established laboratory strains FUMOZ-R and FANG.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not report genotype data, so no supplement is needed for that purpose.

assessment.summary: This study examines the cross-resistance pattern of the pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles funestus strain FUMOZ-R and the susceptible strain FANG to transfluthrin and other pyrethroids. It uses bioassays and biochemical assays to investigate P450-mediated detoxification. No insecticide-resistance markers were genotyped.
